items.reason: A fragrance-free, active-free cleanser that cleans without stripping dry, sensitive-looking skin.
A ceramide moisturizer to support the skin's comfort and soften the look of dryness.
A mineral SPF 50 with zinc oxide is a gentle daily sun protector for fair, easily flushed-looking skin.

response.routine_note: Flushing that lingers, bumps and gritty eyes are best looked at by a dermatologist or eye professional rather than by a stronger product from a shop, so we've kept this to gentle basics and left out exfoliating and retinoid-type actives that could aggravate sensitive skin. Cleanse and moisturize morning and night, then finish the morning with the mineral SPF.
